> Di pasar properti, sisi penawaran bergerak jauh lebih lambat daripada sisi permintaan — itulah sebabnya perubahan minat pembeli lebih dulu terasa di harga, bukan di jumlah unit.

## Konsep Hari Ini

Pasar adalah tempat bertemunya pembeli dan penjual. Sampai di sini, pasar properti sama saja dengan pasar beras atau pasar saham. Bedanya ada pada barang yang diperdagangkan, dan perbedaan itu mengubah hampir semua perilakunya.

**Enam ciri khas pasar properti**

1. **Tidak bisa dipindahkan (imobilitas).** Rumah tidak bisa dikirim. Akibatnya pasar properti selalu bersifat **lokal**. Kelebihan pasokan apartemen di Surabaya tidak menolong pencari rumah di Depok.
2. **Setiap unit unik (heterogen).** Dua rumah di gang yang sama pun berbeda luas, hadap, dan kondisi. Maka tidak ada "harga pasar" tunggal — yang ada rentang harga.
3. **Informasi tidak sempurna.** Harga transaksi sesungguhnya jarang terbuka. Karena itu muncul profesi perantara: agen properti, penilai (KJPP), notaris/PPAT.
4. **Biaya transaksi tinggi dan prosesnya lama.** BPHTB, PPh final penjual, biaya notaris, plus proses persetujuan KPR. Rumah tidak bisa dijual dalam satu klik seperti saham — likuiditasnya rendah.
5. **Penawaran butuh waktu lama.** Perizinan, pembebasan lahan, dan konstruksi memakan waktu satu sampai tiga tahun atau lebih. Dalam jangka pendek, pasokan hampir tidak bisa ditambah — inilah yang disebut **penawaran inelastis**.
6. **Campur tangan pemerintah besar.** Zonasi dan RTRW, KDB/KLB, aturan uang muka (LTV) dari Bank Indonesia, sampai skema rumah subsidi FLPP — semuanya menggeser kurva permintaan atau penawaran.

**Apa yang menggerakkan permintaan**

Permintaan bukan sekadar "ingin", tapi ingin **dan** mampu membayar pada harga tertentu. Pendorongnya: pendapatan rumah tangga, jumlah keluarga baru yang terbentuk, suku bunga KPR, aturan uang muka, harga sewa sebagai alternatif, ekspektasi harga ke depan, dan akses ke lokasi kerja.

**Apa yang menggerakkan penawaran: stok vs aliran**

Ini kunci yang sering terlewat. **Stok** adalah seluruh rumah yang sudah berdiri — jumlahnya sangat besar dan berubah pelan. **Aliran** adalah unit baru yang masuk pasar setiap tahun — jumlahnya kecil, biasanya hanya beberapa persen dari stok. Karena aliran itu kecil, tambahan permintaan tidak bisa langsung dijawab dengan tambahan barang.

**Keseimbangan pasar**

```
Keseimbangan  : jumlah yang diminta = jumlah yang ditawarkan
Permintaan naik + penawaran kaku    -> harga naik tajam, jumlah nyaris tetap
Permintaan naik + penawaran lentur  -> harga naik sedikit, jumlah bertambah
Permintaan turun + penjual menahan  -> transaksi sepi dulu, harga menyusul belakangan
```

Baris terakhir menjelaskan judul tulisan ini. Saat pasar melemah, pemilik rumah cenderung menahan harga karena merasa rugi kalau menjual di bawah harga beli. Yang turun lebih dulu bukan harga, melainkan **volume transaksi**. Harga baru menyesuaikan setelah waktu berjalan — dan biasanya turunnya jauh lebih lambat daripada naiknya.

Efek samping dari jeda konstruksi: pengembang membaca harga tinggi hari ini, lalu membangun. Pasokannya baru datang dua–tiga tahun kemudian, saat permintaan mungkin sudah dingin. Dari sinilah lahir **siklus properti** yang berulang: kelangkaan → harga naik → pembangunan besar-besaran → kelebihan pasokan.

## Dalam Keseharian

Rani bekerja di kawasan Sudirman dan mencari rumah pertama di koridor timur Jakarta, dekat stasiun LRT di Bekasi. Dua tahun lalu rumah dua kamar di sana masih di kisaran Rp700 juta; sekarang penjual meminta Rp850 juta (angka ilustrasi).

Apa yang terjadi? Setelah stasiun beroperasi, waktu tempuh ke kantor memendek. Aksesibilitas naik → **permintaan bergeser ke kanan**. Sementara itu, lahan di radius jalan kaki dari stasiun jumlahnya terbatas dan proyek baru butuh dua–tiga tahun. **Penawaran jangka pendek nyaris tegak lurus.** Ketika permintaan naik dan pasokan tidak bisa mengikuti, yang menyesuaikan adalah harga, bukan jumlah unit.

Sekarang sisi sebaliknya. Misalkan Rani mengambil KPR Rp560 juta (80% dari harga Rp700 juta) dengan tenor 20 tahun:

```
Bunga  8% -> cicilan sekitar Rp4,7 juta/bulan
Bunga 11% -> cicilan sekitar Rp5,8 juta/bulan
```

Kenaikan bunga tiga poin membuat cicilan melonjak sekitar 23% — padahal harga rumahnya tidak berubah sepeser pun. Banyak calon pembeli seperti Rani langsung tidak lolos hitungan bank, dan permintaan bergeser ke kiri. Tapi penjual di kompleks itu tidak serta-merta menurunkan harga. Yang terlihat lebih dulu adalah papan "dijual" yang menempel berbulan-bulan. Inilah wajah nyata dari penyesuaian keseimbangan yang lambat di pasar properti.

## Rangkuman 3 Baris

1. Pasar properti bersifat lokal, heterogen, informasinya tidak sempurna, dan biaya transaksinya tinggi — jadi tidak berperilaku seperti pasar barang biasa.
2. Dalam jangka pendek penawaran hampir tidak bisa bertambah, sehingga guncangan permintaan (bunga KPR, akses transportasi, aturan uang muka) langsung memukul harga.
3. Saat pasar turun, penjual menahan harga; yang lebih dulu anjlok adalah volume transaksi, sedangkan harga menyesuaikan belakangan.

## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

**1.** Ciri mana yang paling menjelaskan mengapa pasar properti bersifat **lokal**?
a) Setiap unit bersifat unik
b) Lokasinya tidak bisa dipindahkan
c) Biaya transaksinya tinggi
d) Pemerintah banyak ikut campur

**2.** (Benar/Salah) Dalam jangka pendek, penawaran properti bersifat elastis sehingga kenaikan permintaan cepat dijawab dengan tambahan unit baru.

**3.** Permintaan rumah di sebuah kawasan naik tajam, sementara penawaran jangka pendek inelastis. Apa yang paling mungkin terjadi?
a) Harga tetap, jumlah unit terjual melonjak
b) Harga naik tajam, jumlah unit nyaris tidak berubah
c) Harga turun karena pengembang panik
d) Tidak ada perubahan sampai izin baru terbit

## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

- **Imobilitas** — sifat properti yang tidak bisa dipindahkan, penyebab utama pasar properti terpecah menjadi pasar-pasar lokal.
- **Heterogenitas** — setiap unit properti berbeda satu sama lain, sehingga yang terbentuk adalah rentang harga, bukan harga tunggal.
- **Penawaran inelastis** — kondisi ketika jumlah barang yang ditawarkan hampir tidak bertambah meski harga naik, khas pasar properti jangka pendek.
- **Stok dan aliran** — stok adalah seluruh properti yang sudah ada; aliran adalah unit baru yang masuk pasar dalam satu periode.
- **LTV (Loan to Value)** — rasio maksimal nilai kredit terhadap harga properti; makin ketat rasionya, makin besar uang muka dan makin kecil permintaan efektif.

---

*Jawaban: 1) b — imobilitas membuat barangnya tidak bisa dikirim ke pasar lain, sehingga pasokan dan permintaan hanya bertemu di wilayah yang sama. 2) Salah — justru sebaliknya: izin dan konstruksi butuh tahunan, sehingga penawaran jangka pendek inelastis. 3) b — ketika pasokan tidak bisa menyesuaikan, seluruh tekanan permintaan diserap oleh harga.*

> Real estate markets obey supply and demand — but the supply can't move, can't be built quickly, and is never quite identical, so prices and rents routinely overshoot in both directions before settling.

## Today's Concept

In an intro economics course, markets clear neatly: price goes up, sellers supply more, buyers demand less, and the market lands on an equilibrium price. Real estate follows the same logic — it just breaks most of the assumptions that make the logic fast and clean.

**Four features that make property markets different**

1. **Immobility (locality).** You can't ship a vacant apartment from Cleveland to Phoenix. Because the good is fixed in place, there is no single "U.S. housing market" — there are thousands of local markets, and they can move in opposite directions in the same quarter. Even within one metro, a 15-minute difference in commute creates a different submarket.

2. **Heterogeneity.** No two properties are identical: lot, floor plan, condition, light, school zone, the neighbor's dog. That's why houses need appraisals while shares of stock don't. There is no single quoted "price" — only a range of negotiated outcomes around an estimated value.

3. **Supply is inelastic in the short run.** Land entitlement, permitting, financing, and construction take years. When demand jumps this spring, the units that answer it deliver in 2028. So the short-run supply curve is close to vertical: a demand surge lands almost entirely on price, not on quantity. And new construction is small relative to what already exists — U.S. completions add roughly 1% to the housing stock in a typical year. The existing stock, and whether its owners choose to list, dominates supply.

4. **Thin markets and high transaction costs.** At any moment a neighborhood may have a handful of buyers and a handful of sellers. Information is private and uneven. Commissions, closing costs, title, and transfer taxes commonly add up to several percent of the price. High friction means transactions are slow and prices are negotiated, not auctioned to a single clearing number.

**What moves each curve**

- *Demand shifters:* household formation and migration, local jobs and income, mortgage rates (buyers shop the monthly payment, not the sticker price), credit availability, expectations about future prices, and the rent-versus-own tradeoff.
- *Supply shifters:* construction and land costs, zoning and permitting, developer financing, the pipeline already under construction, and — often the biggest one in a given year — how willing existing owners are to sell.

**Equilibrium, and how we actually observe it**

```
Equilibrium: quantity demanded = quantity supplied, at the market price
```

We almost never see that point directly in real estate. Instead, practitioners read proxies for how far the market is from balance:

- **Months of supply** = current inventory ÷ the monthly pace of sales. By long-standing convention in U.S. residential brokerage, roughly 4–6 months is considered balanced; well below that is a seller's market, well above is a buyer's market.
- **Vacancy rate vs. natural vacancy rate** on the rental side. Some vacancy is healthy — tenants move, units get turned. Estimates of the "natural" rate for U.S. rentals are usually cited in the mid-single digits; persistently above it, landlords cut rent or offer concessions.
- **Days on market** and the **share of listings with price cuts** — fast, if noisy, temperature checks.

Because supply answers years late, these markets cycle rather than settle. High prices trigger building; the building arrives after demand has cooled; the glut pushes prices down; construction stops; the next shortage forms. Equilibrium in real estate is less a resting place than a line the market keeps crossing.

## In Everyday Life: Austin, Texas

Austin is the cleanest recent illustration in the country.

**2020–2022 — demand shock.** Remote work, tech relocations, and heavy in-migration hit a metro that could not add units in months. Asking rents jumped more than 20% in 2021 alone, and home prices ran up sharply. Nothing about the housing stock had changed — the demand curve shifted right into a near-vertical short-run supply curve, and the entire adjustment came out in price.

**2023–2025 — the supply answer arrives.** Developers had responded, and Austin ended up with one of the highest apartment-completion rates per capita of any large U.S. metro. Those units delivered *after* the in-migration wave slowed. Vacancy climbed, concessions came back ("two months free"), and asking rents fell roughly 5% year over year in 2024 — among the steepest declines of any big metro, in a city people were still moving to. Demand kept growing; delivered supply simply grew faster.

**Meanwhile, on the for-sale side.** A homeowner holding a 3% mortgage from 2021 does not want to list and re-borrow near 7%. That's the **lock-in effect**, and it kept resale inventory unusually tight nationwide even as buyer demand weakened. Note what it is: a leftward shift in the supply of existing homes caused by nothing on a builder's cost sheet. It's a reminder that in real estate, "supply" mostly means *the stock whose owners are willing to trade today*.

And a Cleveland renter felt none of this. Different local market, different curves.

## Three-Line Recap

1. Real estate obeys supply and demand, but immobility, heterogeneity, thin markets, and high transaction costs mean the adjustment is local, slow, and negotiated.
2. Short-run supply is nearly fixed, so demand shocks show up in price first and in quantity only years later — which is exactly what produces boom-and-glut cycles.
3. We infer equilibrium from proxies — months of supply, vacancy versus natural vacancy, days on market — because the market rarely sits still long enough to show it.

## ✅ Self-Quiz

**1.** Why does a sudden demand surge in a metro area push prices up so sharply, instead of just increasing the number of homes sold?

   A. Demand for housing is perfectly elastic
   B. Short-run supply is highly inelastic because construction takes years
   C. Buyers and sellers have identical information
   D. Transaction costs in housing are near zero

**2.** True or False: In U.S. residential brokerage convention, roughly 4–6 months of supply is treated as a balanced market, with less than that favoring sellers.

**3.** An owner with a 3% mortgage declines to sell because a new loan would cost 7%. In supply-and-demand terms, this is best described as:

   A. A rightward shift in demand for existing homes
   B. A leftward shift in the supply of existing homes
   C. A movement along the supply curve
   D. An increase in the natural vacancy rate

## 📚 Today's Terms

- **Immobility (locality)** — Property is fixed in place, so supply cannot relocate to where demand is; markets are inherently local.
- **Heterogeneity** — No two properties are identical, which is why value must be appraised rather than quoted.
- **Short-run supply inelasticity** — The near-vertical supply curve created by multi-year entitlement and construction lags.
- **Months of supply** — Inventory divided by the monthly sales pace; a standard gauge of how far a for-sale market is from balance.
- **Natural vacancy rate** — The healthy baseline share of rental units that are empty due to normal turnover; rents tend to fall when actual vacancy runs above it.

---

*Answers: **1 — B.** With supply effectively fixed for years, a rightward demand shift is absorbed almost entirely by price. **2 — True.** It's a convention, not a law of nature, but 4–6 months is the standard reference band; below it, buyers compete for scarce listings. **3 — B.** The lock-in effect withdraws willing sellers from the market, shifting the existing-home supply curve left — even though construction costs never changed.*

segments.src:
> Jason Cong dari UCLA membuka Design Automation Conference 2025 dengan satu gagasan besar: dengan bantuan deep learning dan transformasi kode otomatis, programmer biasa — bukan hanya insinyur hardware — bisa merancang chip khususnya sendiri.

## Apa yang Dipresentasikan

Pada 25 Juni 2025, di ajang **DAC (Design Automation Conference) ke-62** — konferensi paling berpengaruh di dunia perancangan chip — Prof. **Jason Cong** dari UCLA menyampaikan keynote berjudul *"Democratize Chip Design — with Deep Learning and Automated Code Transformation"*.

Cong bukan nama asing di bidang ini. Ia memimpin **VAST Lab** dan **Center for Domain-Specific Computing (CDSC)** di UCLA, dan ikut mendirikan AutoESL — perusahaan yang produknya kemudian dibeli Xilinx dan menjadi Vivado/Vitis HLS, salah satu perkakas *high-level synthesis* paling banyak dipakai di industri.

Inti pesannya sederhana tapi ambisius: **menutup jurang antara menulis software dan mewujudkannya jadi silikon.**

Selama puluhan tahun, dua dunia ini terpisah tembok tebal. Programmer menulis kode dalam C, C++, atau Python, lalu menjalankannya di prosesor umum. Sementara chip khusus — akselerator AI, chip pengolah video, chip enkripsi — hanya bisa dirancang oleh segelintir insinyur hardware yang menguasai bahasa deskripsi hardware, dan prosesnya bisa memakan waktu berbulan-bulan sampai bertahun-tahun.

Yang ditawarkan Cong: biarkan mesin yang menyeberangi tembok itu. Pendekatannya menggabungkan tiga hal:

1. **High-Level Synthesis (HLS)** — perkakas yang menerjemahkan kode software tingkat tinggi menjadi rancangan sirkuit. Teknologi ini sudah ada, tapi hasilnya sangat bergantung pada cara si penulis menyusun kodenya.
2. **Deep learning** — model yang belajar dari ribuan rancangan sebelumnya untuk *memperkirakan* apakah sebuah versi kode akan menghasilkan chip yang cepat dan hemat daya, tanpa harus benar-benar membangunnya dulu. Dalam berbagai paparannya, Cong menyebut kombinasi **graph neural network (GNN)** untuk merepresentasikan struktur program sebagai graf, *active learning* untuk hemat data latih, pembelajaran lintas-modalitas antara GNN dan **large language model (LLM)**, serta pemodelan *mixture of experts* bertingkat.
3. **Pendekatan agentic dan pemrograman matematis** — agen berbasis LLM yang secara otomatis mengubah, menata ulang, dan menyetel kode agar cocok untuk implementasi hardware.

Riset ini dikerjakan bersama kelompok Prof. **Yizhou Sun** di UCLA — kolaborasi antara ahli EDA (electronic design automation) dan ahli machine learning. Beberapa hasil dari jalur riset lab ini sudah dipublikasikan sebelumnya, misalnya **AutoDSE** (peraih best paper ACM TODAES 2022), **GNN-DSE** (DAC 2022), dan **HARP** (nominasi best paper ICCAD 2023), yang melaporkan peningkatan akurasi prediksi sekitar 29% dan perbaikan performa pencarian rancangan sekitar 1,15 kali dibanding pendekatan sebelumnya.

Keynote-nya bersifat visi dan rangkuman kemajuan, bukan pengumuman satu produk jadi — jadi angka-angka di atas berasal dari makalah-makalah pendukungnya, bukan klaim tunggal dari panggung DAC.

## Mengapa Ini Penting

**Pertama, ini soal siapa yang boleh ikut berinovasi.** Hari ini, kalau kamu punya ide algoritma yang butuh chip khusus agar berjalan 50 kali lebih cepat, kamu praktis harus punya tim hardware dan anggaran besar. Kalau kode software bisa diubah otomatis menjadi rancangan chip yang layak, jumlah orang yang bisa mencoba ide baru melonjak drastis — persis seperti yang terjadi saat pembuatan aplikasi mobile jadi mudah.

**Kedua, ini jawaban atas melambatnya Hukum Moore.** Dulu, kita cukup menunggu prosesor generasi berikutnya untuk mendapat performa lebih. Peningkatan itu kini melambat. Cara utama yang tersisa adalah **domain-specific computing**: membuat chip yang dirancang khusus untuk satu jenis pekerjaan. Masalahnya, merancang chip khusus itu mahal dan lambat. Otomatisasi adalah satu-satunya jalan agar pendekatan ini bisa dipakai luas, bukan hanya oleh perusahaan raksasa.

**Ketiga, dampaknya terasa di keseharian.** Beban komputasi AI, pemrosesan video, dan enkripsi terus membengkak, begitu pula konsumsi listrik pusat data. Chip yang dirancang pas untuk tugasnya bisa mengerjakan hal yang sama dengan daya jauh lebih kecil — artinya baterai ponsel lebih awet, layanan lebih murah, dan jejak energi lebih rendah.

## Memahaminya dengan Mudah

Bayangkan **resep masakan dan dapur restoran**.

Kode software itu seperti resep. Prosesor umum (CPU) adalah dapur rumahan serba guna: satu kompor, satu wajan, bisa masak apa saja — tapi tidak ada yang benar-benar cepat. Chip khusus adalah dapur restoran yang dibangun hanya untuk satu menu: kompor, meja, dan alur kerja disusun persis mengikuti urutan resep, sehingga hidangan keluar berkali lipat lebih cepat dengan energi lebih sedikit.

Masalahnya, mengubah resep menjadi denah dapur adalah pekerjaan arsitek profesional. **High-level synthesis** adalah juru gambar yang bisa membuat denah otomatis dari resep — tapi denahnya sering kurang optimal, karena resep yang ditulis untuk dapur rumahan tidak selalu cocok untuk dapur restoran.

Di sinilah deep learning masuk sebagai **konsultan dapur yang sudah melihat ribuan dapur jadi**. Ia membaca resepmu, menebak layout mana yang akan cepat *sebelum* dapurnya dibangun, lalu menyarankan perubahan resep — "bagian ini kerjakan paralel di empat stasiun", "yang ini jadikan lini berjalan". Dalam praktik HLS, saran seperti itu berbentuk petunjuk singkat yang disisipkan ke dalam kode:

```
// petunjuk untuk perkakas HLS
#pragma HLS pipeline
#pragma HLS unroll factor=4
```

Menemukan kombinasi petunjuk terbaik itulah yang biasanya butuh insinyur berpengalaman dan berminggu-minggu percobaan. Visi Cong: biarkan model AI yang melakukannya, sementara kamu cukup menulis resepnya.

## 3 Baris Ringkasan

1. Di keynote DAC 2025, Jason Cong (UCLA) memaparkan visi **"demokratisasi perancangan chip"** — agar programmer software tanpa latar belakang hardware pun bisa merancang chip dan akselerator sendiri.
2. Kuncinya adalah menggabungkan **high-level synthesis** dengan **deep learning** (graph neural network, LLM, pembelajaran lintas-modalitas) dan **agen otomatis** yang mengubah kode agar pas untuk implementasi silikon.
3. Kalau berhasil, perancangan chip khusus berubah dari proyek mahal bertahun-tahun milik segelintir perusahaan menjadi sesuatu yang bisa dicoba banyak orang — penting di era ketika Hukum Moore melambat dan kebutuhan komputasi AI terus naik.

## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

- **DAC (Design Automation Conference)**: Konferensi akademik-industri terbesar di bidang otomasi perancangan chip; edisi 2025 adalah yang ke-62.
- **High-Level Synthesis (HLS)**: Teknologi yang menerjemahkan kode bahasa tingkat tinggi seperti C/C++ menjadi rancangan sirkuit digital, tanpa menulis bahasa deskripsi hardware secara manual.
- **Graph Neural Network (GNN)**: Jaringan saraf yang bekerja pada data berbentuk graf (titik dan hubungan antar titik) — cocok untuk merepresentasikan struktur program dan sirkuit.
- **Design Space Exploration (DSE)**: Proses mencari kombinasi pilihan rancangan terbaik (paralelisasi, ukuran memori, dan seterusnya) dari sekian banyak kemungkinan.
- **Domain-Specific Computing**: Pendekatan membangun chip yang dioptimalkan untuk satu bidang tugas tertentu, sebagai jawaban atas melambatnya peningkatan performa prosesor umum.
- **Pragma**: Petunjuk singkat yang disisipkan dalam kode untuk memberi tahu perkakas HLS bagaimana sebuah bagian program sebaiknya diwujudkan dalam hardware.

---

**Sumber:** [UCLA CS Newsroom](https://www.cs.ucla.edu/professor-jason-cong-presents-keynote-on-democratize-chip-design-at-the-2025-design-automation-conference/) · [VAST Lab, UCLA](https://vast.cs.ucla.edu/news/2025-06/prof-cong-delivered-keynote-dac%E2%80%992025) · [Program DAC ke-62](https://62dac.conference-program.com/presenter/?uid=322343) · [AI for Chip Design, VAST Lab](https://vast.cs.ucla.edu/projects/ai-chip-design)

> At the world's biggest chip-design conference, UCLA's Jason Cong argued that the next wave of custom silicon should be designed by people who only know how to write software — and showed the AI tooling that is starting to make that possible.

## What He Presented

On June 25, 2025, Jason Cong — Volgenau Chair for Engineering Excellence Professor at UCLA's Computer Science Department — delivered a keynote at the 62nd Design Automation Conference (DAC), the field's premier event for the software that designs chips. His title: **"Democratize Chip Design — with Deep Learning and Automated Code Transformation."**

The problem he set out is easy to state. Today, if you want a custom chip or accelerator tuned to your particular workload, you need a hardware engineer. There aren't many of them, they're expensive, and the work takes months. Meanwhile, there are tens of millions of software developers who know exactly what their code needs — and no practical way to turn that knowledge into silicon.

A partial bridge already exists. It's called **high-level synthesis (HLS)**: you write ordinary C or C++, and a tool generates a hardware design from it. The catch is that the tool only produces something *fast* if you annotate the code with the right hints — directives called **pragmas** that tell it which loops to unroll, which memories to split apart, where to pipeline. Choosing them well is a combinatorial search over billions of possibilities, and getting it wrong can cost you a 100× slowdown. In practice, that's still expert work.

Cong's keynote laid out a vision for removing the expert from that loop, drawing on work at UCLA done in collaboration with Prof. Yizhou Sun's machine learning group. Three ingredients:

- **Deep learning as a fast stand-in for the slow tool.** Actually synthesizing a design to see how it performs can take hours. So the group trains **graph neural networks** on the program's structure — represented as a graph of operations and data flow — to *predict* speed and chip-area cost in seconds. Their HARP model adds a hierarchical view of the program and, importantly, separates the representation of the code from the representation of the optimizations applied to it, which helps the model generalize to programs it has never seen.
- **Mathematical programming instead of trial and error.** Rather than guessing pragmas one at a time, the group's Sisyphus framework folds loop restructuring, pragma insertion, and tile-size selection into a *single* optimization problem and hands it to a solver. In their published evaluation, that produced a geometric-mean speedup of roughly 6× over their own earlier AutoDSE tool on the kernels tested.
- **Agentic AI that rewrites the code, not just the annotations.** This is the "automated code transformation" in the title. Large language models are used not merely to sprinkle hints on your code, but to restructure it into a shape that maps well onto hardware — then check the result and iterate.

The direction has a track record. An earlier UCLA system, AutoDSE, matched the performance of hand-tuned vendor library kernels while using about 26× fewer optimization pragmas — averaging less than one pragma per design.

One honest note on scope: a keynote is a vision talk, not a single result. Cong was surveying a research program and where it's headed, not announcing a finished product.

## Why It Matters

For decades, chips got faster on their own — you wrote code, waited eighteen months, and it ran quicker. That escalator has largely stopped. The remaining way to get big gains is **specialization**: build hardware shaped around one specific job, whether that's a recommendation model, a genome aligner, or a video codec.

The bottleneck is no longer whether specialized hardware works. It's that almost nobody can build it. Every custom accelerator competes for the same scarce pool of hardware engineers, so only workloads at enormous scale — the ones that justify a multi-year, multi-million-dollar design effort — ever get one.

If a competent software developer could get a working accelerator out of their existing code, that calculus changes. The set of problems worth building custom silicon for expands enormously, and it starts to include work done by small teams and academic labs, not just hyperscalers.

There's precedent for this kind of shift. Programmers once hand-wrote assembly language because compilers weren't good enough. Once they were, the number of people who could write useful software increased by orders of magnitude. Cong is proposing the same move one layer down — with the compiler's role now played partly by learned models.

It's worth being clear about what remains unsolved. Automatically generated designs still trail expert hand-tuning on some workloads. The learned predictors need training data, and generalizing to code unlike anything in the training set is an open research problem — which is why the group also builds benchmark suites to measure exactly that. This is a credible direction, not a solved one.

## Making It Simple

Think of writing software as writing a recipe. It assumes one cook, one kitchen, one dish at a time — and any competent cook can follow it.

Designing a chip is not writing a recipe. It's designing the **factory**: how many stations, what moves down the conveyor belt in what order, where ingredients get stored so nothing waits. Handing your recipe to a factory architect gets you a production line, but only after months of expensive back-and-forth.

High-level synthesis was the first attempt at automating that translation — but it only worked if you also handed over detailed notes on how to lay out the floor ("run these two steps in parallel, split this pantry into four"). Writing those notes required knowing how factories work.

What Cong is proposing is a system that reads your recipe, *understands* it well enough to predict how a given factory layout would perform, rewrites the recipe where a different sequence of steps would run better on an assembly line, and designs the floor plan itself. You keep writing recipes. Something else figures out the factory.

## Three-Line Recap

1. At DAC 2025, Jason Cong (UCLA) argued that custom chip design should be accessible to ordinary software developers, not just hardware engineers.
2. His approach combines graph neural networks that predict hardware performance in seconds, mathematical solvers that pick optimizations globally rather than by trial and error, and LLM agents that rewrite source code into hardware-friendly form.
3. If it works at scale, building a custom accelerator becomes something a small team can attempt — though generated designs still trail expert hand-tuning on some workloads.

## 📚 Today's Terms

- **High-Level Synthesis (HLS)** — A tool that takes ordinary software code (typically C/C++) and generates a hardware circuit design from it.
- **Pragma** — A hint added to source code telling the synthesis tool how to build the hardware; the right ones can mean the difference between a fast design and a useless one.
- **Design Space Exploration (DSE)** — The search for the best combination of those hardware design choices among billions of possible configurations.
- **Graph Neural Network (GNN)** — A neural network that learns from data shaped like a network of connected nodes — here, a program represented as a graph of operations and the data flowing between them.
- **FPGA** — A reprogrammable chip whose circuitry can be reconfigured after manufacturing, widely used to prototype and deploy custom accelerators without fabricating a new chip.

id-20260807-news-1.title: Palm Oil and Coal Exports via a Single Door through Danantara Starting September 1: What Changes for Exporters and National Foreign Exchange?

segments.src: Masa transisi pengalihan tata niaga ekspor komoditas strategis dijadwalkan berakhir pada **31 Agustus 2026**.
segments.tr: The transition period for the transfer of strategic commodity export trade management is scheduled to end on **August 31, 2026**.

segments.src: Mulai **1 September 2026**, skema yang disiapkan pemerintah menempatkan **PT Danantara Sumber Daya Indonesia** sebagai pemegang kendali penuh atas rantai ekspor minyak sawit dan batu bara — dari penandatanganan kontrak, penjadwalan pengapalan, hingga penyelesaian pembayaran.
segments.tr: Starting **September 1, 2026**, the scheme prepared by the government places **PT Danantara Sumber Daya Indonesia** as the full controller of the palm oil and coal export chain — from contract signing, shipping schedules, to payment settlement.

segments.src: Perubahan ini bukan sekadar pergantian administrasi.
segments.tr: This change is not merely an administrative shift.

segments.src: Ia menyentuh dua komoditas yang selama bertahun-tahun menjadi tulang punggung neraca perdagangan Indonesia, dan menyangkut ribuan pelaku usaha — dari produsen besar terintegrasi, pedagang menengah, hingga koperasi petani yang selama ini menjual lewat rantai perantara.
segments.tr: It touches two commodities that for years have been the backbone of Indonesia's trade balance, and involves thousands of business actors — from large integrated producers, medium traders, to farmers' cooperatives that have been selling through intermediary chains.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum apa yang secara praktis berubah, siapa yang paling terdampak, dan risiko apa yang perlu diantisipasi ketika seluruh arus dagang mengalir melalui satu pintu.
segments.tr: This article summarizes what practically changes, who is most affected, and what risks need to be anticipated when the entire trade flow flows through a single door.
## Why the Single Door Scheme Emerged

segments.src: Argumen di balik konsolidasi ekspor umumnya berdiri di atas tiga alasan yang berulang dalam debat kebijakan komoditas Indonesia:
segments.tr: The arguments behind export consolidation generally stand on three recurring reasons in Indonesia's commodity policy debates:

segments.src: **Pertama, daya tawar harga.** Indonesia adalah produsen dan pengekspor minyak sawit terbesar di dunia, sekaligus salah satu pemasok batu bara termal terbesar ke pasar Asia.
segments.tr: **First, price bargaining power.** Indonesia is the world's largest producer and exporter of palm oil, as well as one of the largest suppliers of thermal coal to the Asian market.

segments.src: Namun posisi sebagai pemasok dominan selama ini tidak selalu berbanding lurus dengan kemampuan memengaruhi harga acuan.
segments.tr: However, the position as a dominant supplier has not always been directly proportional to the ability to influence reference prices.

segments.src: Harga referensi kerap terbentuk di bursa dan indeks di luar negeri.
segments.tr: Reference prices are often formed in overseas exchanges and indices.

segments.src: Skema terpusat diharapkan mengurangi persaingan sesama eksportir Indonesia yang justru menekan harga jual sendiri.
segments.tr: The centralized scheme is expected to reduce competition among fellow Indonesian exporters, which actually depresses their own selling prices.

segments.src: **Kedua, kepastian devisa.** Sejak Maret 2025, ketentuan Devisa Hasil Ekspor Sumber Daya Alam (DHE SDA) mewajibkan penempatan porsi besar hasil ekspor di sistem keuangan dalam negeri dalam jangka waktu tertentu.
segments.tr: **Second, foreign exchange certainty.** Since March 2025, the Natural Resource Export Proceeds (DHE SDA) provisions require a large portion of export proceeds to be placed in the domestic financial system for a certain period.

segments.src: Persoalan klasiknya adalah pengawasan: dengan ribuan eksportir dan ribuan transaksi, verifikasi menjadi mahal dan lambat.
segments.tr: The classic problem is supervision: with thousands of exporters and thousands of transactions, verification becomes expensive and slow.

segments.src: Bila arus pembayaran melewati satu entitas, jejak devisa secara teoretis lebih mudah dilacak.
segments.tr: If the payment flow passes through a single entity, the foreign exchange trail is theoretically easier to track.

segments.src: **Ketiga, kebocoran penerimaan.** Praktik *under-invoicing*, selisih pencatatan volume, dan transfer pricing lintas yurisdiksi adalah keluhan lama otoritas fiskal pada komoditas ekstraktif.
segments.tr: **Third, revenue leakage.** Under-invoicing practices, discrepancies in volume recording, and cross-jurisdictional transfer pricing are long-standing complaints of fiscal authorities regarding extractive commodities.

segments.src: Satu pintu penjualan mempersempit ruang selisih antara harga kontrak yang dilaporkan dan harga yang benar-benar diterima.
segments.tr: A single sales door narrows the gap between the reported contract price and the price actually received.
The logic is neat on paper.
The question lies in the execution.
## What Changes for Private Exporters
### 1. Shift in Trade Relationship Status

segments.src: Dalam skema lama, eksportir menjual langsung ke pembeli luar negeri, menegosiasikan harga, term pembayaran, dan jadwal kapal secara bilateral.
segments.tr: In the old scheme, exporters sold directly to overseas buyers, negotiating prices, payment terms, and shipping schedules bilaterally.

segments.src: Dalam skema satu pintu, posisi eksportir bergeser menjadi **pemasok ke entitas penyalur**, bukan lagi penjual akhir ke pasar internasional.
segments.tr: In the single door scheme, the exporter's position shifts to being a **supplier to the distributing entity**, no longer the final seller to the international market.
Practical consequences:

segments.src: - Negosiasi harga tidak lagi langsung dengan pembeli akhir, melainkan mengikuti mekanisme harga yang ditetapkan pengelola.
segments.tr: - Price negotiations are no longer direct with the final buyer, but follow the price mechanism set by the manager.

segments.src: - Hubungan jangka panjang dengan *offtaker* luar negeri — yang sering dibangun bertahun-tahun — berpindah tangan.
segments.tr: - Long-term relationships with overseas *offtakers* — often built over years — change hands.

segments.src: - Nilai tambah dari kemampuan *trading* dan lindung nilai (hedging) mandiri berkurang.
segments.tr: - The added value from independent trading and hedging capabilities is reduced.
### 2. Existing Contracts Need Review

segments.src: Kontrak jangka panjang yang jatuh temponya melewati 1 September 2026 adalah titik paling rawan.
segments.tr: Long-term contracts that expire after September 1, 2026, are the most vulnerable point.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang perlu diperiksa oleh tim legal dan komersial:
segments.tr: Several things that legal and commercial teams need to check:

segments.src: - **Klausul novasi/pengalihan** — apakah kontrak mengizinkan pengalihan pihak penjual tanpa persetujuan pembeli?
segments.tr: - **Novation/transfer clauses** — does the contract allow the transfer of the seller party without the buyer's consent?

segments.src: - **Klausul *change of law*** — apakah perubahan regulasi domestik dikategorikan sebagai peristiwa yang membebaskan kewajiban, atau justru memicu penalti?
segments.tr: - **Change of law clauses** — is the change in domestic regulation categorized as an event that releases obligations, or does it trigger penalties?

segments.src: - **Hukum yang berlaku dan forum sengketa** — banyak kontrak komoditas tunduk pada hukum Inggris atau Singapura dengan arbitrase di luar negeri. Regulasi domestik tidak otomatis membatalkan kewajiban kontraktual di forum tersebut.
segments.tr: - **Governing law and dispute forum** — many commodity contracts are subject to English or Singaporean law with arbitration overseas. Domestic regulations do not automatically cancel contractual obligations in those forums.

segments.src: - **Sanksi keterlambatan pengapalan (*demurrage*)** — siapa menanggung bila jadwal kapal bergeser akibat proses transisi?
segments.tr: - **Shipping delay penalties (*demurrage*)** — who bears the cost if the shipping schedule shifts due to the transition process?
### 3. Cash Flow Rhythm May Change

segments.src: Ini isu yang paling langsung terasa.
segments.tr: This is the most immediately felt issue.

segments.src: Dalam ekspor langsung, pembayaran umumnya melalui *Letter of Credit* atau transfer setelah dokumen pengapalan lengkap — dengan siklus yang sudah dikenal.
segments.tr: In direct exports, payments are generally via *Letter of Credit* or transfer after shipping documents are complete — with a known cycle.

segments.src: Bila pembayaran ke pemasok domestik dilakukan setelah entitas penyalur menerima dana dari pembeli akhir, akan ada **jeda tambahan** dalam rantai.
segments.tr: If payment to domestic suppliers is made after the distributing entity receives funds from the final buyer, there will be an **additional delay** in the chain.

segments.src: Bagi produsen besar dengan kas kuat, jeda beberapa pekan mungkin terkelola.
segments.tr: For large producers with strong cash, a delay of a few weeks may be manageable.

segments.src: Bagi pemasok menengah, kontraktor tambang, dan koperasi petani yang bergantung pada perputaran cepat, jeda itu bisa berarti kesulitan membayar upah, solar, atau pupuk.
segments.tr: For medium suppliers, mining contractors, and farmers' cooperatives that rely on fast turnover, that delay could mean difficulty in paying wages, diesel, or fertilizer.
**What needs to be ensured before September 1:**

segments.src: - Berapa lama tenggat pembayaran (*payment terms*) yang dijanjikan kepada pemasok domestik?
segments.tr: - How long are the payment terms promised to domestic suppliers?

segments.src: - Apakah tersedia skema pembayaran di muka, anjak piutang, atau fasilitas talangan perbankan?
segments.tr: - Are there advance payment schemes, factoring, or bank bridging facilities available?

segments.src: - Bagaimana mekanisme klaim bila pembayaran terlambat?
segments.tr: - What is the claim mechanism if payment is delayed?
### 4. Administrative Burden and Compliance Costs

segments.src: Setiap pengalihan sistem membawa biaya adaptasi: registrasi ulang, penyesuaian sistem dokumen, sertifikasi mutu, pencocokan standar pelaporan.
segments.tr: Every system transfer brings adaptation costs: re-registration, adjustment of document systems, quality certification, matching reporting standards.

segments.src: Untuk sawit, sertifikasi keberlanjutan (termasuk kepatuhan pada regulasi impor negara tujuan seperti aturan deforestasi Uni Eropa) menambah lapisan dokumen yang harus tetap terjaga rantai ketertelusurannya meski penjual formalnya berubah.
segments.tr: For palm oil, sustainability certifications (including compliance with destination country import regulations such as EU deforestation rules) add a layer of documents that must maintain traceability even if the formal seller changes.

segments.src: ## Yang Berubah bagi Penerimaan Negara dan Devisa
segments.tr: ## What Changes for State Revenue and Foreign Exchange
### Expected Positive Side
| Aspect | Expected Improvement |

segments.src: | Pemantauan DHE | Satu titik rekonsiliasi, verifikasi lebih cepat |
segments.tr: | DHE Monitoring | Single reconciliation point, faster verification |

segments.src: | Harga jual | Kurangnya persaingan sesama pemasok domestik menekan diskon |
segments.tr: | Selling Price | Lack of competition among domestic suppliers reduces discounts |

segments.src: | Penerimaan pajak & bea keluar | Basis harga lebih seragam, selisih pelaporan menyempit |
segments.tr: | Tax & Export Duty Revenue | More uniform price base, reporting discrepancies narrow |

segments.src: | Data perdagangan | Statistik volume dan harga lebih terkonsolidasi |
segments.tr: | Trade Data | Volume and price statistics are more consolidated |
### Side That Needs Safeguarding

segments.src: Konsolidasi tidak otomatis menghasilkan devisa lebih besar.
segments.tr: Consolidation does not automatically result in greater foreign exchange.
Several determining factors:

segments.src: - **Volume tetap terjaga.** Devisa adalah fungsi harga dikali volume. Bila proses transisi menyebabkan pengapalan tertunda, penerimaan kuartalan bisa turun meski harga naik.
segments.tr: - **Volume remains maintained.** Foreign exchange is a function of price multiplied by volume. If the transition process causes shipping delays, quarterly revenue could drop even if prices rise.

segments.src: - **Pembeli tidak berpindah pemasok.** Pasar batu bara termal dan minyak nabati punya alternatif. Ketika pasokan dari satu negara dianggap kurang pasti jadwalnya, pembeli besar cenderung menyebar risiko ke pemasok lain — Australia, Afrika Selatan, Rusia untuk batu bara; Malaysia, minyak kedelai Amerika Selatan, atau minyak bunga matahari Laut Hitam sebagai substitusi sebagian untuk minyak nabati.
segments.tr: - **Buyers do not switch suppliers.** The thermal coal and vegetable oil markets have alternatives. When supply from one country is considered to have an uncertain schedule, large buyers tend to spread risk to other suppliers — Australia, South Africa, Russia for coal; Malaysia, South American soybean oil, or Black Sea sunflower oil as partial substitutes for vegetable oil.

segments.src: - **Biaya operasional entitas pengelola.** Margin yang tertahan di entitas penyalur adalah margin yang tidak sampai ke produsen. Transparansi struktur biaya menentukan apakah konsolidasi benar-benar menambah nilai atau sekadar memindahkannya.
segments.tr: - **Operational costs of the managing entity.** The margin held by the distributing entity is a margin that does not reach the producer. Transparency of the cost structure determines whether consolidation truly adds value or merely shifts it.
## Four Risks Worth Monitoring

segments.src: Risiko titik tunggal kegagalan (*single point of failure*).**
segments.tr: Single point of failure risk.**

segments.src: Ketika satu sistem menangani seluruh volume ekspor dua komoditas terbesar, gangguan teknis, antrean dokumen, atau kemacetan proses persetujuan berdampak nasional — bukan hanya pada satu perusahaan.
segments.tr: When one system handles the entire export volume of the two largest commodities, technical disruptions, document queues, or approval process bottlenecks have a national impact — not just on one company.

segments.src: Kesiapan kapasitas TI, jumlah SDM, dan prosedur cadangan menjadi krusial.
segments.tr: IT capacity readiness, human resource numbers, and backup procedures become crucial.

segments.src: Risiko tata kelola dan konflik kepentingan.**
segments.tr: Governance and conflict of interest risk.**

segments.src: Entitas yang sekaligus menetapkan harga, memilih pembeli, dan menyalurkan pembayaran memegang kewenangan sangat besar.
segments.tr: An entity that simultaneously sets prices, chooses buyers, and distributes payments holds immense authority.

segments.src: Praktik terbaik yang biasanya diminta pengamat: audit independen berkala, publikasi harga acuan yang dapat diverifikasi, mekanisme keluhan yang jelas bagi pemasok, dan pemisahan fungsi antara penetapan harga dan pelaksanaan penjualan.
segments.tr: Best practices usually requested by observers: periodic independent audits, publication of verifiable reference prices, clear complaint mechanisms for suppliers, and separation of functions between price setting and sales execution.
Trading partner response risk.**

segments.src: Pengaturan ekspor yang terpusat bisa memicu pertanyaan dari mitra dagang terkait komitmen di forum perdagangan multilateral, terutama menyangkut pembatasan ekspor dan perlakuan terhadap pelaku usaha.
segments.tr: Centralized export arrangements can trigger questions from trading partners regarding commitments in multilateral trade forums, especially concerning export restrictions and treatment of business actors.

segments.src: Indonesia pernah menghadapi sengketa terkait kebijakan komoditas sebelumnya, sehingga desain hukum kebijakan ini akan diamati.
segments.tr: Indonesia has faced disputes related to previous commodity policies, so the legal design of this policy will be observed.

segments.src: Risiko rantai bawah yang tidak terlihat.**
segments.tr: Invisible downstream chain risk.**

segments.src: Petani swadaya sawit dan pemasok kecil batu bara jarang muncul dalam pemberitaan kebijakan, tetapi merekalah yang paling cepat terpukul bila harga tandan buah segar atau harga beli di mulut tambang tertekan akibat pergeseran margin di rantai atas.
segments.tr: Independent palm oil farmers and small coal suppliers rarely appear in policy news, but they are the ones hit fastest if the price of fresh fruit bunches or the purchase price at the mine mouth is depressed due to margin shifts in the upper chain.
## Practical Checklist Before September 1

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha, beberapa langkah yang umumnya masuk akal dilakukan sekarang:
segments.tr: For business actors, several steps that are generally reasonable to take now:

segments.src: 1. **Inventarisasi kontrak** yang aktif melewati 31 Agustus 2026, lengkap dengan volume, tenor, dan klausul kritis.
segments.tr: 1. **Inventory of contracts** active beyond August 31, 2026, complete with volume, tenor, and critical clauses.

segments.src: 2. **Konsultasi hukum** untuk menilai eksposur pada kontrak berhukum asing.
segments.tr: 2. **Legal consultation** to assess exposure on contracts under foreign law.

segments.src: 3. **Simulasi arus kas** dengan asumsi jeda pembayaran tambahan 30, 60, dan 90 hari.
segments.tr: 3. **Cash flow simulation** assuming additional payment delays of 30, 60, and 90 days.

segments.src: 4. **Konfirmasi status registrasi** dan kelengkapan dokumen pada sistem yang berlaku.
segments.tr: 4. **Confirmation of registration status** and completeness of documents in the applicable system.

segments.src: 5. **Komunikasi proaktif dengan pembeli lama** agar hubungan komersial tidak putus dan reputasi keandalan pasokan terjaga.
segments.tr: 5. **Proactive communication with old buyers** so that commercial relationships are not severed and supply reliability reputation is maintained.

segments.src: 6. **Amankan fasilitas modal kerja** perbankan sebagai penyangga bila terjadi keterlambatan.
segments.tr: 6. **Secure banking working capital facilities** as a buffer if delays occur.

segments.src: 7. **Pantau pengumuman resmi** — aturan pelaksana dan petunjuk teknis pada kebijakan sebesar ini kerap terbit mendekati tanggal berlaku, dan bisa mengubah detail operasional secara signifikan.
segments.tr: 7. **Monitor official announcements** — implementing regulations and technical guidelines for a policy of this scale often emerge close to the effective date and can significantly change operational details.

segments.src: ## Indikator yang Menentukan Berhasil atau Tidaknya
segments.tr: ## Indicators That Determine Success or Failure

segments.src: Dalam tiga hingga enam bulan pertama, beberapa angka akan berbicara lebih jujur daripada pernyataan siapa pun:
segments.tr: In the first three to six months, several figures will speak more honestly than anyone's statements:

segments.src: - **Volume pengapalan bulanan** dibanding periode yang sama tahun sebelumnya — indikator paling cepat untuk mendeteksi kemacetan.
segments.tr: - **Monthly shipping volume** compared to the same period last year — the fastest indicator to detect bottlenecks.

segments.src: - **Selisih harga jual Indonesia terhadap harga acuan internasional** — apakah menyempit (daya tawar naik) atau melebar.
segments.tr: - **Difference between Indonesia's selling price and international reference prices** — whether it narrows (bargaining power increases) or widens.
- **Average payment time to domestic suppliers.**

segments.src: - **Realisasi penempatan DHE** di sistem keuangan dalam negeri.
segments.tr: - **Realization of DHE placement** in the domestic financial system.

segments.src: - **Harga di tingkat produsen**, khususnya harga tandan buah segar petani dan harga jual batu bara pemasok kecil.
segments.tr: - **Price at the producer level**, especially the price of fresh fruit bunches for farmers and the selling price for small coal suppliers.

segments.src: - **Neraca perdagangan bulanan** dan pergerakan cadangan devisa.
segments.tr: - **Monthly trade balance** and movement of foreign exchange reserves.

segments.src: Bila volume stabil, selisih harga menyempit, dan pembayaran ke pemasok lancar, kebijakan ini punya dasar kuat untuk dilanjutkan.
segments.tr: If volume is stable, the price difference narrows, and payments to suppliers are smooth, this policy has a strong basis to continue.

segments.src: Bila salah satu dari ketiganya memburuk secara konsisten, ruang evaluasi perlu dibuka lebih awal — sebelum kerugian mengendap di lapisan pelaku usaha yang paling rentan.
segments.tr: If any of the three deteriorate consistently, the space for evaluation needs to be opened earlier — before losses settle in the most vulnerable layers of business actors.
## Closing

segments.src: Konsolidasi ekspor komoditas strategis adalah salah satu perubahan struktural terbesar dalam tata niaga Indonesia dalam beberapa dekade terakhir.
segments.tr: The consolidation of strategic commodity exports is one of the largest structural changes in Indonesia's trade management in recent decades.

segments.src: Potensi manfaatnya nyata: daya tawar yang lebih besar, devisa yang lebih terpantau, dan kebocoran yang lebih sempit.
segments.tr: The potential benefits are real: greater bargaining power, better monitored foreign exchange, and narrower leakages.

segments.src: Risikonya pun sama nyatanya: kemacetan operasional, tekanan arus kas di rantai bawah, dan konsentrasi kewenangan yang menuntut tata kelola sangat rapi.
segments.tr: The risks are equally real: operational bottlenecks, cash flow pressure in the downstream chain, and concentration of authority that demands very neat governance.

segments.src: Yang menentukan bukan desain di atas kertas, melainkan kualitas pelaksanaan pada bulan-bulan pertama — seberapa cepat dokumen diproses, seberapa tepat waktu pembayaran cair, dan seberapa terbuka harga yang dipakai.
segments.tr: What determines success is not the design on paper, but the quality of execution in the first few months — how quickly documents are processed, how timely payments are disbursed, and how transparent the prices used are.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini disusun sebagai ulasan informatif dan analisis umum, bukan nasihat hukum, pajak, maupun rekomendasi investasi. Ketentuan teknis kebijakan dapat berubah melalui aturan pelaksana. Pembaca dan pelaku usaha disarankan memverifikasi ketentuan terbaru melalui kanal resmi kementerian/lembaga terkait dan berkonsultasi dengan penasihat profesional sebelum mengambil keputusan bisnis.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is prepared as an informative review and general analysis, not as legal, tax, or investment advice. Technical provisions of the policy may change through implementing regulations. Readers and business actors are advised to verify the latest provisions through official channels of the relevant ministries/agencies and consult with professional advisors before making business decisions.

id-20260807-news-3.title: SE Number 18 of 2026: Gadgets Restricted in Schools, Not Totally Banned — Your School Determines the Limit

segments.src: Aturan soal gawai di sekolah kembali menjadi bahan obrolan di grup orang tua murid.
segments.tr: Rules regarding gadgets in schools have once again become a topic of conversation in parents' groups.

segments.src: Pemicunya adalah Surat Edaran (SE) Mendikdasmen Nomor 18 Tahun 2026 yang mengatur pembatasan penggunaan gawai di satuan pendidikan.
segments.tr: The trigger is the Circular Letter (SE) of the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education Number 18 of 2026, which regulates the restriction of gadget use in educational units.

segments.src: Kata kuncinya penting untuk digarisbawahi sejak awal: **pembatasan**, bukan pelarangan menyeluruh.
segments.tr: The keyword is important to underline from the start: **restriction**, not a total ban.

segments.src: Namun justru di situ letak pertanyaan besarnya.
segments.tr: However, that is precisely where the big question lies.

segments.src: Jika yang diatur adalah "batas", siapa yang menentukan di mana batas itu ditarik?
segments.tr: If what is regulated is the "limit," who determines where that limit is drawn?

segments.src: Jawabannya, menurut semangat surat edaran tersebut, diserahkan kepada masing-masing sekolah melalui tata tertib internal.
segments.tr: The answer, according to the spirit of the circular letter, is left to each school through internal regulations.

segments.src: Artinya, aturan di sekolah anak Anda bisa berbeda dengan aturan di sekolah tetangga — dan keduanya sama-sama sah.
segments.tr: This means the rules at your child's school may differ from the rules at a neighbor's school — and both are equally valid.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum apa yang perlu dipahami murid, orang tua, dan guru, serta di mana potensi kebingungan yang mungkin muncul di lapangan.
segments.tr: This article summarizes what students, parents, and teachers need to understand, as well as the potential confusion that may arise in the field.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu Surat Edaran, dan Sekuat Apa Daya Ikatnya?
segments.tr: ## What Is a Circular Letter, and How Binding Is It?

segments.src: Sebelum masuk ke isi, ada baiknya memahami bentuk hukumnya lebih dulu, karena hal ini sering disalahpahami.
segments.tr: Before diving into the content, it is helpful to understand its legal form first, as this is often misunderstood.

segments.src: Surat edaran adalah instrumen kebijakan yang bersifat pemberitahuan, imbauan, dan pedoman teknis dari pejabat berwenang kepada jajaran di bawahnya.
segments.tr: A circular letter is a policy instrument that serves as a notification, appeal, and technical guideline from an authorized official to their subordinates.

segments.src: Ia bukan undang-undang, bukan peraturan pemerintah, dan bukan peraturan menteri yang punya sanksi pidana atau denda administratif langsung kepada warga.
segments.tr: It is not a law, not a government regulation, and not a ministerial regulation that carries criminal sanctions or direct administrative fines for citizens.
The consequences are:

segments.src: - Surat edaran **mengikat secara administratif** ke dalam — dinas pendidikan, kepala sekolah, dan satuan pendidikan diminta menindaklanjutinya.
segments.tr: - A circular letter is **administratively binding** internally — education offices, school principals, and educational units are asked to follow up on it.

segments.src: - Kekuatan operasionalnya baru terasa ketika **diturunkan menjadi tata tertib sekolah**, yang memang punya mekanisme pembinaan sendiri.
segments.tr: - Its operational strength is only felt when it is **translated into school regulations**, which indeed have their own disciplinary mechanisms.

segments.src: - Karena itu, kalimat "gawai dilarang oleh pemerintah" kurang tepat. Yang lebih akurat: pemerintah meminta sekolah membatasi, lalu sekolah menyusun aturan mainnya.
segments.tr: - Therefore, the phrase "gadgets are banned by the government" is inaccurate. More accurately: the government asks schools to restrict them, and then the schools draft the rules of play.

segments.src: Perbedaan ini bukan sekadar soal istilah.
segments.tr: This difference is not just a matter of terminology.

segments.src: Ia menentukan ke siapa orang tua harus bertanya ketika ada keberatan: bukan ke kementerian, melainkan ke sekolah tempat aturan itu benar-benar dirumuskan.
segments.tr: It determines who parents should ask when there is an objection: not the ministry, but the school where the rules were actually formulated.
## Points Commonly Regulated

segments.src: Berdasarkan penjelasan yang beredar di ruang publik, arah pengaturan SE ini berkisar pada beberapa hal berikut.
segments.tr: Based on explanations circulating in the public sphere, the direction of this SE's regulation revolves around several things.

segments.src: Rincian persisnya tetap perlu dibaca langsung pada dokumen resmi, karena rumusan tiap poin bisa lebih spesifik daripada ringkasan mana pun.
segments.tr: Exact details still need to be read directly from the official document, as the wording of each point may be more specific than any summary.

segments.src: Pembatasan berlaku di seluruh jenjang satuan pendidikan.**
segments.tr: Restrictions apply across all levels of educational units.**

segments.src: Cakupannya menyasar lingkungan pendidikan dasar dan menengah secara umum, bukan hanya jenjang tertentu.
segments.tr: The scope targets primary and secondary education environments in general, not just a specific level.

segments.src: Namun bentuk pembatasan diharapkan menyesuaikan usia dan kematangan peserta didik — pendekatan untuk kelas 2 SD tentu tidak sama dengan kelas 12 SMA.
segments.tr: However, the form of restriction is expected to adjust to the age and maturity of the students — the approach for 2nd grade elementary school is certainly not the same as 12th grade high school.

segments.src: Fokusnya pada penggunaan pribadi selama jam belajar.**
segments.tr: The focus is on personal use during learning hours.**

segments.src: Yang dibatasi terutama adalah penggunaan gawai pribadi untuk keperluan non-akademik pada saat kegiatan belajar berlangsung: media sosial, gim, streaming, dan sejenisnya.
segments.tr: What is primarily restricted is the use of personal gadgets for non-academic purposes during learning activities: social media, games, streaming, and the like.
Use for learning remains possible.**

segments.src: Inilah alasan mengapa ini bukan larangan total.
segments.tr: This is why it is not a total ban.

segments.src: Ketika gawai digunakan sebagai alat bantu belajar — riset tugas, praktik literasi digital, asesmen berbasis komputer, kelas pemrograman, atau kebutuhan mata pelajaran tertentu — penggunaannya dibuka dengan sepengetahuan dan arahan guru.
segments.tr: When gadgets are used as learning aids — assignment research, digital literacy practice, computer-based assessments, programming classes, or specific subject needs — their use is permitted with the knowledge and direction of the teacher.

segments.src: Ada ruang pengecualian untuk kebutuhan khusus.**
segments.tr: There is room for exceptions for special needs.**

segments.src: Kondisi kesehatan tertentu, kebutuhan aksesibilitas bagi peserta didik disabilitas, atau keperluan darurat komunikasi umumnya masuk kategori yang perlu diakomodasi.
segments.tr: Certain health conditions, accessibility needs for students with disabilities, or emergency communication needs generally fall into categories that need to be accommodated.

segments.src: Bentuk akomodasinya diserahkan pada kebijakan sekolah.
segments.tr: The form of accommodation is left to school policy.

segments.src: Detail teknis diserahkan ke tata tertib sekolah.**
segments.tr: Technical details are left to school regulations.**
This is the most decisive point.

segments.src: Mekanisme penitipan, jam yang diperbolehkan, prosedur izin, hingga bentuk pembinaan bila ada pelanggaran — semuanya dirumuskan di tingkat sekolah, idealnya bersama komite sekolah dan dengan sosialisasi ke orang tua.
segments.tr: The mechanism for storage, permitted hours, permission procedures, and the form of discipline if there are violations — all are formulated at the school level, ideally together with the school committee and with socialization to parents.
## Why Are the Details Left to the School?

segments.src: Pendekatan ini punya logika yang masuk akal, sekaligus konsekuensi yang tidak ringan.
segments.tr: This approach has a logical rationale, as well as significant consequences.

segments.src: **Argumen yang mendukung:** kondisi sekolah di Indonesia sangat beragam.
segments.tr: **Supporting arguments:** school conditions in Indonesia are very diverse.

segments.src: Ada sekolah yang setiap murid membawa ponsel, ada yang sebagian besar tidak.
segments.tr: Some schools have every student bringing a phone, some have most not bringing one.

segments.src: Ada sekolah dengan laboratorium komputer memadai, ada yang justru mengandalkan gawai murid untuk asesmen digital.
segments.tr: Some schools have adequate computer labs, while others rely on students' gadgets for digital assessments.

segments.src: Ada murid yang berangkat sendiri naik angkutan umum sejauh puluhan kilometer dan butuh berkabar dengan orang tua, ada yang diantar-jemput.
segments.tr: Some students travel alone by public transport for dozens of kilometers and need to update their parents, while others are dropped off and picked up.

segments.src: Aturan tunggal yang kaku berisiko tidak adil bagi sebagian dari mereka.
segments.tr: A single, rigid rule risks being unfair to some of them.

segments.src: **Argumen yang mengkhawatirkan:** ketika norma umum diserahkan pada penafsiran ratusan ribu satuan pendidikan, hasilnya bisa sangat tidak seragam.
segments.tr: **Concerning arguments:** when general norms are left to the interpretation of hundreds of thousands of educational units, the results can be very inconsistent.

segments.src: Sekolah yang berhati-hati mungkin menerapkan aturan paling ketat agar aman dari teguran.
segments.tr: Cautious schools might implement the strictest rules to be safe from reprimands.
Other schools might implement them loosely.
Both feel they have carried out the circular.

segments.src: Di sinilah kebingungan baru berpotensi lahir.
segments.tr: This is where new confusion potentially arises.
## Potential Points of Confusion
### One family, two different rules

segments.src: Orang tua dengan dua anak di sekolah berbeda bisa menghadapi dua rezim aturan sekaligus.
segments.tr: Parents with two children in different schools may face two different rule regimes simultaneously.

segments.src: Anak sulung boleh membawa ponsel dengan syarat dititipkan di loker kelas; adiknya sama sekali tidak boleh membawa.
segments.tr: The eldest child may bring a phone on the condition that it is stored in the class locker; the younger child may not bring one at all.

segments.src: Menjelaskan inkonsistensi ini kepada anak bukan pekerjaan mudah, apalagi bagi anak usia sekolah dasar yang sangat peka pada rasa adil.
segments.tr: Explaining this inconsistency to children is not an easy task, especially for elementary school children who are very sensitive to fairness.
### Phones as family coordination tools

segments.src: Bagi banyak keluarga, ponsel anak bukan gaya hidup, melainkan alat koordinasi: mengabari jam pulang berubah, meminta dijemput saat hujan, atau memberi tahu kegiatan ekstrakurikuler mendadak.
segments.tr: For many families, a child's phone is not a lifestyle, but a coordination tool: notifying changes in pickup time, asking to be picked up during rain, or informing about sudden extracurricular activities.

segments.src: Sekolah yang menerapkan penitipan penuh perlu menyiapkan jalur komunikasi pengganti yang benar-benar berfungsi — nomor telepon sekolah yang aktif, petugas piket yang responsif, atau kanal resmi wali kelas.
segments.tr: Schools that implement full storage need to prepare alternative communication channels that actually work — active school phone numbers, responsive picket officers, or official homeroom teacher channels.

segments.src: Tanpa itu, kebijakan yang niatnya baik akan terasa memberatkan.
segments.tr: Without this, a well-intentioned policy will feel burdensome.
### Responsibility for stored items

segments.src: Jika sekolah mewajibkan penitipan gawai, muncul pertanyaan praktis: siapa yang bertanggung jawab bila perangkat rusak atau hilang?
segments.tr: If the school requires gadget storage, a practical question arises: who is responsible if the device is damaged or lost?

segments.src: Tata tertib yang matang sebaiknya menjawab hal ini secara eksplisit, lengkap dengan wadah penyimpanan yang layak dan pencatatan sederhana.
segments.tr: Mature regulations should answer this explicitly, complete with proper storage containers and simple recording.

segments.src: Ketidakjelasan pada titik ini adalah sumber sengketa yang paling sering terjadi di banyak sekolah.
segments.tr: Lack of clarity at this point is the most frequent source of disputes in many schools.
### The line between "learning tool" and "distraction"

segments.src: Guru berada di posisi paling sulit.
segments.tr: Teachers are in the most difficult position.

segments.src: Ketika satu murid membuka ponsel untuk mencari referensi tugas dan murid lain membuka aplikasi hiburan, keduanya terlihat sama dari kejauhan.
segments.tr: When one student opens a phone to search for assignment references and another student opens an entertainment app, both look the same from a distance.

segments.src: Tanpa panduan kelas yang jelas — misalnya aturan "layar terbuka menghadap ke depan" atau sesi penggunaan yang ditentukan waktunya — guru bisa terjebak menjadi pengawas perangkat alih-alih pengajar.
segments.tr: Without clear classroom guidance — for example, a "screen open facing forward" rule or timed usage sessions — teachers can get trapped as device supervisors instead of educators.

segments.src: ### Perbedaan penerapan antarguru di sekolah yang sama
segments.tr: ### Differences in implementation between teachers in the same school

segments.src: Bahkan di dalam satu sekolah, penerapan bisa berbeda antarguru.
segments.tr: Even within one school, implementation can differ between teachers.

segments.src: Satu guru mengizinkan pemakaian untuk tugas kelompok, guru lain melarang sepenuhnya.
segments.tr: One teacher allows use for group assignments, another teacher forbids it entirely.

segments.src: Bagi murid, ketidakkonsistenan semacam ini lebih membingungkan daripada aturan ketat yang diterapkan seragam.
segments.tr: For students, such inconsistency is more confusing than a strict rule applied uniformly.
## Why Is This Issue Emerging Now?

segments.src: Perhatian terhadap penggunaan gawai di ruang kelas bukan fenomena khas Indonesia.
segments.tr: Attention to gadget use in the classroom is not a phenomenon unique to Indonesia.

segments.src: Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, sejumlah negara dan otoritas pendidikan di berbagai benua mulai menata ulang kebijakan ponsel di sekolah, dengan model yang beragam: ada yang melarang penuh di jam sekolah, ada yang membatasi per jenjang usia, ada pula yang menyerahkannya pada otonomi sekolah seperti pendekatan yang kini ditempuh di Indonesia.
segments.tr: In recent years, several countries and education authorities across various continents have begun restructuring phone policies in schools, with diverse models: some ban them entirely during school hours, some restrict them by age group, and some leave it to school autonomy, like the approach now taken in Indonesia.

segments.src: Dorongannya umumnya berasal dari tiga kekhawatiran yang berulang: konsentrasi belajar yang mudah terpecah oleh notifikasi, dinamika sosial di kelas yang bergeser ke layar, serta risiko perundungan siber yang berlanjut hingga ke dalam lingkungan sekolah.
segments.tr: The drive generally comes from three recurring concerns: learning concentration easily broken by notifications, social dynamics in class shifting to screens, and the risk of cyberbullying continuing into the school environment.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat, temuan penelitian di bidang ini belum bulat.
segments.tr: It should be noted that research findings in this field are not unanimous.

segments.src: Sebagian studi menunjukkan perbaikan fokus setelah pembatasan diberlakukan, sebagian lain menemukan efeknya bergantung pada konteks, kualitas pendampingan guru, dan bagaimana aturan itu dikomunikasikan.
segments.tr: Some studies show improved focus after restrictions are implemented, while others find the effect depends on context, the quality of teacher guidance, and how the rules are communicated.

segments.src: Konsensus yang paling banyak disepakati justru bukan pada "larang atau tidak", melainkan pada pentingnya **pendampingan literasi digital** — mengajari murid kapan dan bagaimana menggunakan teknologi, bukan sekadar menjauhkannya.
segments.tr: The most widely agreed-upon consensus is not on "ban or not," but on the importance of **digital literacy guidance** — teaching students when and how to use technology, not just keeping it away.
## What Can Be Done Now
### For parents

segments.src: 1. **Baca tata tertib sekolah, bukan hanya berita.** Aturan yang mengikat anak Anda ada di dokumen sekolah, bukan di ringkasan media sosial.
segments.tr: 1. **Read the school regulations, not just the news.** The rules binding your child are in the school documents, not in social media summaries.

segments.src: 2. **Tanyakan tiga hal konkret ke wali kelas:** apakah gawai boleh dibawa, di mana disimpan selama jam belajar, dan bagaimana prosedur menghubungi anak dalam keadaan mendesak.
segments.tr: 2. **Ask three concrete things to the homeroom teacher:** whether gadgets may be brought, where they are stored during learning hours, and what the procedure is for contacting the child in an emergency.

segments.src: 3. **Ajukan pengecualian secara tertulis bila memang dibutuhkan** — misalnya untuk kondisi kesehatan yang memerlukan pemantauan. Permintaan tertulis lebih mudah ditindaklanjuti daripada percakapan lisan.
segments.tr: 3. **Request exceptions in writing if indeed needed** — for example, for health conditions requiring monitoring. Written requests are easier to follow up on than oral conversations.

segments.src: 4. **Gunakan forum komite sekolah** jika ada keberatan. Tata tertib yang disusun bersama biasanya lebih mudah dipatuhi daripada yang diumumkan sepihak.
segments.tr: 4. **Use the school committee forum** if there are objections. Regulations drafted together are usually easier to follow than those announced unilaterally.

segments.src: 5. **Selaraskan aturan di rumah.** Pembatasan di sekolah tidak banyak berarti jika di rumah tidak ada kesepakatan apa pun soal waktu layar.
segments.tr: 5. **Align rules at home.** Restrictions at school do not mean much if there is no agreement at home regarding screen time.
### For students

segments.src: - Pastikan Anda tahu persis aturan sekolah — termasuk pengecualiannya. Banyak pelanggaran terjadi karena murid hanya mendengar versi lisan yang berubah-ubah.
segments.tr: - Make sure you know exactly the school rules — including the exceptions. Many violations occur because students only hear changing oral versions.

segments.src: - Bila membutuhkan gawai untuk keperluan belajar, minta izin lebih dulu. Meminta izin jauh lebih ringan daripada menjelaskan setelahnya.
segments.tr: - If you need a gadget for learning purposes, ask for permission first. Asking for permission is much easier than explaining afterward.

segments.src: - Simpan nomor kontak penting dan cara menghubungi keluarga lewat jalur sekolah, sebagai cadangan bila ponsel sedang dititipkan.
segments.tr: - Save important contact numbers and ways to contact family through school channels, as a backup when the phone is being stored.
### For teachers and schools

segments.src: - Rumuskan aturan yang **spesifik dan bisa diukur**. "Gawai disimpan di loker kelas sejak bel masuk hingga bel istirahat" jauh lebih mudah dijalankan daripada "gawai dibatasi penggunaannya".
segments.tr: - Formulate rules that are **specific and measurable**. "Gadgets are stored in class lockers from the start bell until the break bell" is much easier to implement than "gadget use is restricted."

segments.src: - Terapkan **satu standar untuk semua kelas** agar tidak muncul kesenjangan penerapan antarguru.
segments.tr: - Apply **one standard for all classes** so that gaps in implementation between teachers do not arise.

segments.src: - Sediakan **kanal komunikasi darurat** yang jelas dan diketahui semua orang tua.
segments.tr: - Provide a clear **emergency communication channel** known to all parents.

segments.src: - Pilih pendekatan **pembinaan, bukan penghukuman**. Penyitaan berkepanjangan atau sanksi yang mempermalukan murid berisiko menimbulkan masalah baru dan bisa dipersoalkan orang tua.
segments.tr: - Choose an approach of **guidance, not punishment**. Prolonged seizure or sanctions that shame students risk creating new problems and can be questioned by parents.

segments.src: - Sosialisasikan aturan sebelum diberlakukan, dan beri masa transisi.
segments.tr: - Socialize the rules before they are implemented, and provide a transition period.
## Frequently Asked Questions

segments.src: **Apakah anak saya tetap boleh membawa ponsel ke sekolah?**
segments.tr: **Is my child still allowed to bring a phone to school?**
It depends on the school regulations.

segments.src: SE ini tidak melarang membawa secara nasional; yang diatur adalah pembatasan penggunaannya, dan detailnya ditentukan sekolah.
segments.tr: This SE does not ban bringing them nationally; what is regulated is the restriction of their use, and the details are determined by the school.

segments.src: **Apakah ada sanksi hukum bagi murid yang melanggar?**
segments.tr: **Are there legal sanctions for students who violate the rules?**
A circular letter is not a criminal instrument.

segments.src: Konsekuensi yang mungkin timbul adalah pembinaan sesuai tata tertib sekolah, bukan sanksi hukum.
segments.tr: The consequences that may arise are guidance according to school regulations, not legal sanctions.

segments.src: **Bagaimana dengan ujian atau asesmen berbasis digital?**
segments.tr: **What about digital-based exams or assessments?**

segments.src: Kegiatan pembelajaran dan asesmen yang memang memerlukan perangkat umumnya tetap berjalan, karena penggunaan untuk keperluan akademik di bawah arahan guru bukan yang menjadi sasaran pembatasan.
segments.tr: Learning and assessment activities that indeed require devices generally continue, as use for academic purposes under teacher direction is not the target of the restriction.

segments.src: **Sekolah anak saya menerapkan aturan yang jauh lebih ketat dari sekolah lain.
segments.tr: **My child's school implements rules that are much stricter than other schools.
Is this allowed?**

segments.src: Boleh, selama tata tertib itu disusun melalui mekanisme yang berlaku di sekolah dan tidak melanggar hak dasar peserta didik.
segments.tr: Yes, as long as the regulations are drafted through the applicable mechanism at the school and do not violate the basic rights of students.

segments.src: Jika ada keberatan, jalur yang tepat adalah membicarakannya dengan sekolah dan komite sekolah.
segments.tr: If there are objections, the correct path is to discuss it with the school and the school committee.
## Closing

segments.src: Inti dari SE Nomor 18 Tahun 2026 sebenarnya sederhana: negara menetapkan arah, sekolah menetapkan takarannya.
segments.tr: The essence of SE Number 18 of 2026 is actually simple: the state sets the direction, the school sets the measure.

segments.src: Model ini memberi ruang bagi keragaman kondisi di lapangan, tetapi hanya akan berhasil bila sekolah benar-benar menyusun aturan yang jelas, melibatkan orang tua, dan menerapkannya secara konsisten.
segments.tr: This model provides space for the diversity of conditions in the field, but it will only succeed if schools truly draft clear rules, involve parents, and apply them consistently.

segments.src: Tanpa itu, yang terjadi bukan pembatasan yang tertib, melainkan kebingungan yang tersebar — di mana setiap murid, orang tua, dan guru memiliki versi aturannya sendiri.
segments.tr: Without that, what happens is not an orderly restriction, but widespread confusion — where every student, parent, and teacher has their own version of the rules.

segments.src: Karena itu, langkah paling berguna yang bisa dilakukan hari ini bukan berdebat soal setuju atau tidak setuju, melainkan membaca tata tertib sekolah masing-masing dan memastikan semua pihak memahami hal yang sama.
segments.tr: Therefore, the most useful step that can be taken today is not to debate whether to agree or disagree, but to read the respective school regulations and ensure all parties understand the same thing.

segments.src: *Catatan: artikel ini disusun sebagai penjelasan umum berdasarkan informasi yang beredar di ruang publik dan tidak menggantikan dokumen resmi.
segments.tr: *Note: this article is compiled as a general explanation based on information circulating in the public sphere and does not replace official documents.

segments.src: Untuk rumusan yang akurat dan terbaru, silakan merujuk pada naskah surat edaran yang diterbitkan kementerian, dinas pendidikan setempat, atau tata tertib resmi sekolah yang bersangkutan.
segments.tr: For accurate and up-to-date formulations, please refer to the circular letter text published by the ministry, local education office, or the official regulations of the respective school.
Provisions may change at any time.*
